text:
alex_h: Quick sync — I ran into a few model intake edge cases when importing the new opensource-2.7 checkpoint. Wanted to propose a tiny refactor to the onboarding flow to catch these earlier.
maya_r: go on. what were the failures?
alex_h: Mostly subtle compatibility mismatches: tokenizer special tokens not present in model config, ONNX export failing on dynamic axes, and a KV cache shape mismatch that only shows up at seq_len=8192. Also a perf regression vs similar model (~12% slower p95).
prateek_s: ugh. sounds like we need both a functional gate (does it run) and a shape/contract gate (does kv/past_key_values align). current admit checks are too coarse.
dana_ops: can you list the concrete checks you want? we should keep this fast — onboarding shouldn't add >10m latency.
alex_h: sure. proposed lightweight gates in order:
1) manifest sanity: model config, tokenizer files, model signature present. quick JSON schema check.
2) cpu-smoke: load model on CPU with quantized/float path, run 5 synthetic prompts (short/long) to verify codepaths.
3) kv-shape-check: small harness to call forward with seq_len=1 then seq_len=512 then seq_len=8192 to assert past_key_values shapes match expected (ndims and dtype).
4) onnx-export-check: attempt export with dynamic axes; fail only if export crash or outputs differ > eps on sample inputs.
5) perf-sample: run 2-min bench on a single worker at typical batch sizes to estimate p95 and peak-memory. this can be async and nonblocking but must produce a pass/fail vs baseline.
6) diff-eval: run small seed eval set; if quality drop > X% flag for manual review.
prateek_s: I like splitting fast gates (1-3) vs slower gates (4-6). fast gates should be synchronous (<3m). slower ones can be queued and mark model as "provisionally admitted".
maya_r: how do we avoid blocking rollout if perf-sample hangs on rare randomness? timebox it and auto-fallback to "needs human".
alex_h: agreed. timebox 5m for perf-sample; if timeout -> requires human signoff. also add a quick fallback policy in the manifest that maps to a compatible runtime variant (smaller kv layout/2x quantized) to keep serving.
sam_bench: bench-bot results for the last import showed p95 12% slower, but peak mem identical. logs indicate extra memcpy in attention kernel. could be kernel selection for that op.
dana_ops: kernel selection is runtime/inference infra area — need an interface: model registry should include meta-hints (preferred kernel tags, fused_attention_supported: true/false) that runtime can consume.
prateek_s: propose adding a small "compatibility shim" artifact produced at onboarding: a JSON with keys {signature, kv_layout, tokenizer_fingerprint, runtime_hints}. runtime uses it for routing and fallback.
maya_r: good. format sketch?
alex_h: example:
```
{
  "signature": "v1.2-model-type:causal",
  "kv_layout": "interleaved|layerwise",
  "tokenizer_sha256": "abc123...",
  "runtime_hints": ["fused_attn_v2", "prefer_fp16_kernels"]
}
```
prateek_s: add "smoke_prompts_hash" too so evals can reuse cached prefixes and caching layer can validate prefix compatibility.
sam_bench: bench-bot: +1 to kv_layout. we've seen mismatches when models were converted with different ordering. Having kv_layout lets runtime adapt or fail early.
alex_h: next: where to run ONNX/export check? CI or a dedicated conversion worker pool? I don't want it flaking in CI.
dana_ops: dedicated conversion workers in eng-infra pool. they can run heavier checks and be retried. CI only runs manifest/CPU-smoke/kv-shape quick checks.
maya_r: ownership: eng-ml owns the gating logic and shim format, eng-infra owns conversion workers and kernel hints mapping, runtime team consumes shim. agree?
prateek_s: yep. action items:
- alex: write PR with shim schema + unit tests (due EOD Tue)
- sam: add kv-shape-check harness to bench repo (Weds)
- maya: update intake pipeline to split fast/sync gates and enqueue slow ones (Fri)
- dana: provision conversion worker + ONNX runner (next week)
bench-bot: queued perf-sample job 1955012345-ps-1 for new-import-881; ETA ~8m.
infra-bot: created task ENGINFRA-3222 for conversion workers.
maya_r: one more: we should surface clear user-facing statuses in registry UI: "admitted: provisional", "admitted: verified", "blocked: kv-mismatch" etc.
alex_h: agreed. also need telemetry events for gate failures so we can slice by model-family and conversion path.
prateek_s: ok cool. i'll draft an RFC follow-up doc with schema and gating flow. will ping owners in thread when ready.
maya_r: thanks all. def add a short set of smoke prompts (3-4) that exercise tokenizer edge tokens and long context. put them in repo as fixtures.
alex_h: will do. thanks :thumbsup:
sam_bench: bench-bot: perf-sample job completed: p95 delta -11.8% vs baseline, peak_mem delta +0.4%. job id 1955012345-ps-1. logs: link https://internal/bench/1955012345-ps-1
alex_h: saw logs — kernel selector fallback triggered on layer 12. filed infra issue.
maya_r: great thread. we'll track RFC + tasks. closing here unless anyone objects.
